title: Field extension: toggle
description: Whether the field is something more — entered in a test matrix, among others —: its glyph alone in the strip under the field, lit while on, its label under the pointer, pressed to switch. A value of its own (`value`), sent back beside the field's under `<field>__toggle` — « 1 » or « 0 » —, the field's value never touched.

value.description: On or off. An extension carrying `value` holds a value of its own, sent back under `<field>__<extension>`.

label.description: What it says, under the pointer: « In the test matrix ».
